observations: Default ask_when_relevant. Four choices use exact source config keys.
Plater::open_3mf_file promotes Ask When Relevant to a choice only for a nonempty Add/drop model.
Explicit Plater::load_project default originfile=- calls determine_load_type without that promotion after close_with_confirm.
ProjectDropDialog default action2 is Import geometry only; only Open as project and Import geometry only radios are offered. Remember choice is commented out.
Explicit geometry Open resets the model; Add geometry appends with an Import Object snapshot.
limitations: Compiled16-case reference covers native load decisions using GUI/config adapters; it does not validate native mesh import.
Existing web geometry loader still flattens native parts/instances and omits painting, object settings and plate assignments. Mixed/multiple 3MF choices remain incomplete.
